title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics expand in GCC and GCC High
summary: The roadmap facts, cloud qualifications, licensing sources and documented controls support the briefing. Minor corrections should complete two policy-wizard paths and distinguish the environment requirements page's 50-licence rule from the Copilot Dashboard page's different access and processing requirements.

claims.quote: We are expanding the availability of Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics capabilities in Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC, or GCC-M) and GCC High (GCC-H).

claims.claim: The web app control is reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote:
Select Create a policy.
Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy.

claims.fix: Complete the path to the setting: 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app > feature > Access setting', selecting Viva Insights and the Viva Insights web app feature. The initial Settings is the admin center's settings menu; the second is the Viva Settings tab. See https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center and https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/admin/manage-settings-copilot-dashboard.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy with ModuleId VivaInsights, FeatureId 'Viva Insights web app', IsFeatureEnabled $false and Everyone creates a tenant-wide policy disabling the web app.
claims.quote:
Example: Turn off the Viva Insights web app for all users in your tenant
ModuleId : VivaInsights
FeatureId : Viva Insights web app
Name : DisableFeatureForAll
IsFeatureEnabled : false
Everyone

claims.claim: The analyst publishing control is reached through Microsoft 365 admin center > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy.
claims.quote:
Select Create a policy.
Name the policy and select the app and feature for which you'd like to set the policy.

claims.fix: Complete the path to the setting: 'Settings > Viva > Settings > Manage feature access > Create a policy > app > feature > Access setting', selecting Viva Insights and Analyst report publish. See https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/control-access-admin-center and https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/insights/advanced/analyst/publish-reports.

claims.claim: Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy -ModuleId VivaInsights -FeatureId AnalystReportPublish -Name <policy name> -IsFeatureEnabled $false -Everyone creates a policy disabling analyst report publishing tenant-wide.
claims.quote:
Now that you have the featureID, use the Add-VivaModuleFeaturePolicy PowerShell cmdlet to create an access policy for the feature.
If you want to disable the feature for all users, use the -Everyone parameter instead.
